mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the risk-free rate and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A recent drop in the federal funds rate below 0.15% signals an aggressive monetary policy response to economic stress, leading to a short-term rebound in equity markets and positive 5-day forward returns.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to economic stress
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% and employment levels fall below 140,000 thousand, it indicates a severe labor market deterioration that triggers a temporary stock market sell-off, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5% AND PAYEMS < 140000.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market recovery regime (HOUST > 1400 and RSAFS > 500000) signals improving consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1400 AND RSAFS > 500000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.5 signals a contraction in the real economy, leading to a short-term negative reaction in equity markets and negative 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 101.0 (2017 base) indicates a strengthening real economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 101.0.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) falls below 17280 billion dollars and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it indicates dual stress in the real economy and housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 17280 AND HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 259.5 and FEDFUNDS > 0.15%), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative returns over the next 60 days as the central bank tightens policy to combat inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 259.5 AND FEDFUNDS > 0.15%.
